name: Compliant AI outreach template (example)
description: Example pitch designed for AI voice agents. Discloses AI identity up front, states real org + reason, asks consent before any PII, offers opt-out and human handoff. Replace bracketed placeholders before any use. Never use for legal threats, debt collection, or unverifiable claims.

segments.text: Hello {firstName}, this is an automated AI assistant calling on behalf of [ORG_NAME]. This call is being recorded for quality. Is now a bad time, or may I have thirty seconds to explain why I am calling?

Thank you. I am following up because [VERIFIABLE_REASON, e.g. you downloaded our pricing guide on DATE]. I do not have any legal authority and I am not offering legal advice. If you want to verify me, you can reach [ORG_NAME] at [PUBLIC_PHONE] or [PUBLIC_URL], reference case [REF_IF_ANY]. Would you like me to continue, or should I remove your number?

Understood. I will not ask for bank details, wire records, or passwords on this call. If you are interested, the next step is a short human follow-up at a time you choose, and I can email the details to an address you provide. Otherwise say stop and I will end the call and mark you as do-not-call. What would you prefer?
